title: Microburst waveform cluster-level export — Oct 05 2026
content:
Microburst waveform export: cluster-level breakdown (generated from dashboard derivative)
Export window: 2026-10-04T00:00:00Z -> 2026-10-04T23:59:59Z
Aggregation: 1h rollups + microburst-counts detected by spike detector v2
Notes: this sheet focuses on short, high-amplitude utilization spikes (microbursts) rather than sustained load. Values are per-cluster; pool labels indicate logical allocation groups.

CSV_COLUMNS: hour_start, cluster_id, region, pool, avg_gpu_util_pct, p95_gpu_util_pct, max_gpu_util_pct, microburst_events, avg_slices_in_use, free_slots, dominant_job_category, notes

2026-10-04T00:00Z, cluster-alpha-1, us-west1, infer-pool-large, 31.4, 72.1, 98.7, 12, 14.2, 6, realtime-llm, "midnight maintenance batch left transient KV-cache churn -> short spikes"
2026-10-04T01:00Z, cluster-beta-2, eu-west1, train-pool, 9.8, 18.6, 21.2, 1, 2.1, 22, offline-train, "quiet window"
2026-10-04T08:00Z, cluster-alpha-1, us-west1, infer-pool-large, 49.6, 85.4, 99.9, 27, 22.8, 0, realtime-llm, "morning traffic ramp, multiple tiny batching spikes"
2026-10-04T09:00Z, cluster-delta-3, ap-southeast1, burst-pool, 62.7, 94.2, 100.0, 34, 28.6, 1, rerank, "sustained high p95, several microbursts correlated with cache misses"
2026-10-04T12:00Z, cluster-gamma-4, us-east1, infer-pool-small, 18.9, 44.0, 76.5, 8, 9.4, 11, assistant, "lunch slump then spike from scheduled job"
2026-10-04T15:00Z, cluster-alpha-1, us-west1, infer-pool-large, 55.1, 91.3, 100.0, 41, 26.9, 0, realtime-llm, "peak routing window, KV warmup incomplete -> lots of tiny bursts"
2026-10-04T16:00Z, cluster-delta-3, ap-southeast1, burst-pool, 71.4, 98.0, 100.0, 59, 30.1, 0, rerank, "region-wide campaign drove high p95 and microburst density"
2026-10-04T18:00Z, cluster-epsilon-5, eu-central1, reserved-pool, 27.3, 53.7, 80.8, 6, 10.7, 13, batch-inference, "scheduled nightly jobs beginning early"
2026-10-04T22:00Z, cluster-alpha-1, us-west1, infer-pool-large, 38.7, 76.9, 99.6, 18, 15.4, 5, realtime-llm, "evening traffic tail with several spikes"

Summary insights:
- Microburst density (events/hour) is concentrated in two clusters: cluster-alpha-1 (us-west1) and cluster-delta-3 (ap-southeast1). These two contributed ~60% of detected events for the day.
- High p95 values (>=90%) coincide with low free_slots, indicating that bursts happen when headroom is thin. Several clusters report max_gpu_util ~100% during events.
- There are distinct region patterns: APAC cluster-delta-3 shows the highest event counts and longest sustained p95 periods; EU clusters show lower density but occasional tall spikes likely from scheduled batch conversions.
- Dominant job categories causing spikes: realtime-llm and rerank. Offline training generally shows low microburst density but sustained low utilization.

Anomalies of interest (flagged rows):
- cluster-delta-3 @ 16:00Z: 59 microburst_events, p95 98.0%. Correlates with marketing campaign (linked_artifacts INFRA-1428) and an increase in short-lived rerank jobs. Risk: route-level SLO violations if repeat.
- cluster-alpha-1 @ 15:00Z: 41 microburst_events with zero free_slots. Multiple small jobs with poor batching observed — potential batching config mismatch.
- cluster-gamma-4 @ 12:00Z: max_gpu_util 76.5 but p95 44.0 — indicates one tall spike rather than sustained high-load; follow-up suggests a maintenance job overlapped with traffic.

Quick recommendations (for capacity / ops):
- Short term: enable temporary burst-capacity policy on cluster-delta-3 for APAC daytime window (12:00-18:00 local) to add 2-4 slots during campaign spikes.
- Mid term: audit batching config for the realtime-llm route pinned to infer-pool-large. Target: reduce microburst count by 30% by improving batch formation (hint: lower client-side min_batch_delay and enable more aggressive server-side aggregation).
- Long term: add microburst-aware autoscaling trigger (event-rate based) to complement token-rate triggers; tune to open 1-2 free_slots preemptively when predicted event density > 15/hour.

Operational notes for SRE/Capacity planners:
- Raw hour-by-hour CSV attached to dashboard export (see linked_artifacts). Use the spike detector v2 parameters: threshold=0.65, min_duration=30s, merge_gap=20s.
- Suggested playbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFRA/GPU+Microburst+Playbook (included in linked_artifacts).

Action items (owners):
- Ayesha Patel: prototype temporary burst-capacity policy and validate on cluster-delta-3 (due 2026-10-09).
- Zoe Kim: run a batching-parameter A/B on a canary subset of infer-pool-large (due 2026-10-12).
- Marcus Chen: add microburst event-rate chart to daily ops digest and add a runbook note for 0->2 slot pre-warming (due 2026-10-08).

Misc: this export intentionally focuses on microburst characteristics (count and amplitude) to complement daily sustained-utilization exports. Use together with standard daily_rollup sheets for a full capacity plan view.
